    settings=["disable_help_flag", "disable_version_flag"] aliases=[]
    arg backend long=Some("backend") short=None aliases=None values=["cpu", "gpu", "metal", "vulkan"] defaults=["cpu"] hidden=false short_help_hidden=false heading=Some("Execution")
      index=None action=Set num_args=None value_names=Some(["BACKEND"]) delimiter=None terminator=None parser=Backend flags=[] conflicts=[]
      help "Choose the execution backend: cpu (the default) or gpu"
      long "Execution backend: cpu (the default) or gpu.\n\nValues:\n  cpu     CPU execution (the default)\n  gpu     A GPU through the platform's native API: Metal on macOS, Vulkan elsewhere\n  metal   A GPU through Metal (macOS)\n  vulkan  A GPU through Vulkan (Linux; also other platforms with a Vulkan driver, unqualified there)\n\nAn unavailable GPU fails; device failure does not silently retry on CPU."
    arg grounder long=Some("grounder") short=None aliases=None values=["auto", "lazy", "eager"] defaults=["auto"] hidden=false short_help_hidden=false heading=Some("Execution")
      index=None action=Set num_args=None value_names=Some(["GROUNDER"]) delimiter=None terminator=None parser=Grounder flags=[] conflicts=[]
      help "Grounding mode, independent of execution backend"
      long "Grounding mode, independent of execution backend.\n\n`eager` instantiates every rule before solving. `lazy` instantiates on demand: relational source joins on CPU or GPU, or, for formula inputs, a producer core checked by the selected backend with eligible constraints streamed on the host. Terminal definitions (derived predicates nothing reads) can be reconstructed per answer. Objectives require complete constraint checks before scoring and disable terminal deferral. Table joins are refused. `auto` admits relational source joins where it can, else instantiates an eager base and defers terminal definitions. Resource allowances still apply."
    arg formula_joins long=Some("formula-joins") short=None aliases=None values=["indexed", "table"] defaults=["indexed"] hidden=false short_help_hidden=true heading=Some("Advanced controls")

      long "Positive joins during eager formula grounding.\n\nTable reuses support masks for eligible flat patterns. Relational source grounding and support-growth rounds retain indexed joins. Preparation consumes the configured support storage and records grounding work."
    arg source_batching long=Some("source-batching") short=None aliases=None values=["independent", "union", "worlds"] defaults=["independent"] hidden=false short_help_hidden=true heading=Some("Advanced controls")

command zetesis | An answer-set solver
  settings=["subcommand_required", "disable_help_subcommand"] aliases=[]
  command solve | Find answer sets; use - explicitly for standard input
    settings=["disable_help_flag", "disable_version_flag"] aliases=[]
    arg backend long=Some("backend") short=None aliases=None values=["cpu", "gpu", "metal", "vulkan"] defaults=["cpu"] hidden=false short_help_hidden=false heading=Some("Execution")
      index=None action=Set num_args=None value_names=Some(["BACKEND"]) delimiter=None terminator=None parser=Backend flags=[] conflicts=[]
      help "Choose the execution backend: cpu (the default) or gpu"
      long "Execution backend: cpu (the default) or gpu.\n\nValues:\n  cpu     CPU execution (the default)\n  gpu     A GPU through the platform's native API: Metal on macOS, Vulkan elsewhere\n  metal   A GPU through Metal (macOS)\n  vulkan  A GPU through Vulkan (Linux; also other platforms with a Vulkan driver, unqualified there)\n\nAn unavailable GPU fails; device failure does not silently retry on CPU."
    arg grounder long=Some("grounder") short=None aliases=None values=["auto", "lazy", "eager"] defaults=["auto"] hidden=false short_help_hidden=false heading=Some("Execution")
      index=None action=Set num_args=None value_names=Some(["GROUNDER"]) delimiter=None terminator=None parser=Grounder flags=[] conflicts=[]
      help "Grounding mode, independent of execution backend"
      long "Grounding mode, independent of execution backend.\n\n`eager` instantiates every rule before solving. `lazy` instantiates on demand: relational source joins on CPU or GPU, or, for formula inputs, a producer core checked by the selected backend with eligible constraints streamed on the host. Terminal definitions (derived predicates nothing reads) can be reconstructed per answer. Objectives require complete constraint checks before scoring and disable terminal deferral. Table joins are refused. `auto` admits relational source joins where it can, else instantiates an eager base and defers terminal definitions. Resource allowances still apply."
    arg formula_joins long=Some("formula-joins") short=None aliases=None values=["indexed", "table"] defaults=["indexed"] hidden=false short_help_hidden=true heading=Some("Advanced controls")
